"""Independent reread of local evidence bytes; integrity only, never human approval."""
import base64
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
E = ROOT / 'docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V02/i02-handoff-p2-p3-20261015'
ENV = {**os.environ, 'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS': '0', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1'}

def sha(raw):
    return sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def save(name, value):
    (E / name).write_bytes((json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))

def read(name):
    return json.loads((E / name).read_bytes().decode('utf-8', errors='strict'))

assert not (E / 'evidence-inventory.json').exists(), 'Refuse overwrite of completed evidence inventory'
intake = read('intake.json')
raw_receipts = read('raw-command-receipts.json')['receipts']
checked_receipts = 0
for label, record in raw_receipts.items():
    for key, value in record.items():
        if key.endswith('_base64'):
            raw = base64.b64decode(value, validate=True)
            assert sha(raw) == record[key.removesuffix('_base64') + '_sha256']
            checked_receipts += 1

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('new_helper_guard', E / 'verify_helper_sources.py')
guard = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(guard)
original_guard = guard.verify(read('helper-sources-v2.json'), intake['helper_source_pins'], ROOT)
helper_reads = 0
for bundle in [read('helper-sources-v2.json'), read('reproduction-tools.json')]:
    for name, record in bundle['sources'].items():
        raw = base64.b64decode(record['raw_bytes_base64'], validate=True)
        assert record['source_encoding'] == 'utf-8'
        assert sha(raw) == record['raw_sha256'] and len(raw) == record['raw_size']
        assert record['source_utf8'].encode('utf-8') == raw
        assert sha(record['source_utf8'].encode('utf-8')) == record['source_utf8_sha256']
        assert (ROOT / name).read_bytes() == raw and (ROOT / name).read_bytes() == raw
        helper_reads += 2
seal_raw = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
save('evidence-verifier-source.json', {'source_encoding': 'utf-8', 'raw_bytes_base64': base64.b64encode(seal_raw).decode('ascii'),
    'raw_sha256': sha(seal_raw), 'raw_size': len(seal_raw), 'source_utf8': seal_raw.decode('utf-8'),
    'source_utf8_sha256': sha(seal_raw), 'scope': 'This local evidence integrity verifier is not independent human review or an R03 approval'})

paths = [p for p in sorted(E.iterdir()) if p.is_file()]
allowed = intake['modified']
patterns = {'private_key': rb'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----',
    'github_token': rb'\b(?:gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{50,})\b',
    'aws_key': rb'\b(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\b',
    'openai_key': rb'\bsk-(?:proj-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}\b'}
inputs = [(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)), p.read_bytes()) for p in paths]
inputs += [(name, (ROOT / name).read_bytes()) for name in allowed]
for label, receipt in raw_receipts.items():
    for key, value in receipt.items():
        if key.endswith('_base64'):
            inputs.append((label + ':' + key, base64.b64decode(value, validate=True)))
inputs += [('current-diff', base64.b64decode(read('source-diff.json')['diff_base64'], validate=True)),
    ('prior-diff', base64.b64decode(intake['prior_diff_base64'], validate=True)),
    ('negative-independent-audit', base64.b64decode(intake['independent_audit_report_base64'], validate=True))]
for bundle in [read('helper-sources-v2.json'), read('reproduction-tools.json')]:
    inputs += [(name, base64.b64decode(rec['raw_bytes_base64'], validate=True)) for name, rec in bundle['sources'].items()]
hits = [{'path': path, 'signature': name} for path, raw in inputs for name, pattern in patterns.items() if re.search(pattern, raw)]
assert not hits, hits
save('secrets-scan.json', {'known_signature_hits': hits, 'scanned_inputs': len(inputs),
    'scope': 'Five scoped sources; all new evidence at scan time; decoded command bytes, helper sources, prior/current diffs and preserved negative audit',
    'test_credentials': 'Only documented synthetic fixture credentials in captured commands; no live provider or production credentials introduced',
    'limit': 'Known-signature scan and scoped diff review; not a universal proof about arbitrary unknown secret formats'})

protected = 0
for name, pin in intake['snapshot_sha256'].items():
    if name not in allowed:
        assert sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == pin, name
        protected += 1
assert protected == 1845
assert sha(Path(intake['independent_audit_report_path']).read_bytes()) == intake['independent_audit_report_sha256']
git = lambda *a: subprocess.check_output(['git', *a], cwd=ROOT, env=ENV)
index_path = Path(git('rev-parse', '--git-path', 'index').decode().strip())
assert sha(index_path.read_bytes()) == intake['index_sha256']
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == intake['head']
assert git('branch', '--show-current').decode().strip() == intake['branch']
assert set(git('diff', '--name-only').decode().splitlines()) == set(allowed)
assert not git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
for name, record in read('changed-bytes.json')['files'].items():
    assert sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == record['working_sha256']

checks = []
for p in sorted(E.iterdir()):
    if not p.is_file():
        continue
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    assert not raw.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf') and b'\r' not in raw, p.name
    result = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--no-index', '--check', '--', '/dev/null', str(p)],
        cwd=ROOT, env=ENV, capture_output=True)
    assert result.returncode == 1 and not result.stdout and not result.stderr, (p.name, result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
    checks.append({'path': p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), 'exit_code': result.returncode,
        'stdout_base64': '', 'stderr_base64': '', 'interpretation': 'New-file difference1, zero whitespace diagnostics; not PASS/0'})
save('new-records-whitespace.json', {'checks': checks, 'diagnostics': 0,
    'scope': 'All new files existing before this whitespace receipt and inventory; these two generated records are checked on final reread'})
save('evidence-inventory.json', {'self_excluded': 'evidence-inventory.json', 'approval': 'NONE; local byte inventory only',
    'checks': {'raw_streams_rehashed': checked_receipts, 'helper_physical_reads': helper_reads,
        'standalone_original_guard': original_guard, 'protected_files_unchanged': protected, 'source_index_unchanged': True},
    'files': [{'path': p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), 'size': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(p.read_bytes())}
        for p in sorted(E.iterdir()) if p.is_file() and p.name != 'evidence-inventory.json']})
inventory = read('evidence-inventory.json')
expected = {r['path'] for r in inventory['files']}
actual = {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for p in E.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name != 'evidence-inventory.json'}
assert expected == actual
for record in inventory['files']:
    first, second = (ROOT / record['path']).read_bytes(), (ROOT / record['path']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(first) == sha(second) == record['sha256'] and len(first) == record['size']
for name in ['new-records-whitespace.json', 'evidence-inventory.json']:
    p = E / name
    result = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--no-index', '--check', '--', '/dev/null', str(p)], cwd=ROOT, env=ENV, capture_output=True)
    assert result.returncode == 1 and not result.stdout and not result.stderr
    print(json.dumps({'file': name, 'whitespace_exit': result.returncode, 'diagnostics': 0}))
untracked = git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines()
assert all(p in intake['untracked'] or p.startswith(E.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() + '/') for p in untracked)
assert len(untracked) == 27 + len(actual) + 1
assert sha(index_path.read_bytes()) == intake['index_sha256']
print(json.dumps({'result': 'LOCAL_EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_PASS', 'independent_review': 'PENDING',
    'new_files': len(actual) + 1, 'total_untracked': len(untracked), 'modified_tracked': len(allowed),
    'index_unchanged': True, 'head_unchanged': True, 'raw_streams_rehashed': checked_receipts,
    'inventory_sha256': sha((E / 'evidence-inventory.json').read_bytes())}))
scope: This local evidence integrity verifier is not independent human review or an R03 approval
